original_ai_output.title_zh: 莫桑比克：克利马内主教谋杀案被拘留人数升至五人
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 据《O País》报道，克利马内已故主教多姆·奥索里奥·西托拉·阿丰索于今年6月6日在主教住所遇害，与此案相关的被拘留人数已从四人增至五人，其中包括两名神父、一名教区保安和两名平民。赞比西亚省首席检察官弗雷迪·贾马尔表示，案件调查仍在进行，目前尚未查明作案的具体情节。该案目前仍为单一来源报道，谋杀案的具体情况尚未得到确认。

key_facts.fact: 克利马内主教多姆·奥索里奥·西托拉·阿丰索于今年6月6日在主教住所遇害
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: the murder of the late Bishop of Quelimane, Dom Osório Citora Afonso, which took place on 6 June this year at his episcopal residence

key_facts.fact: 与此案相关的被拘留人数已从四人增至五人
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The number of individuals detained in connection with the murder ... has risen from four to five.

key_facts.fact: 被拘留者包括两名神父、一名教区保安和两名平民
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Those detained include two priests, a security guard from the Diocese of Quelimane and two civilians.

key_facts.fact: 赞比西亚省首席检察官弗雷迪·贾马尔表示，案件调查仍在进行
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The information was provided by the Provincial Chief Prosecutor of Zambézia, Freddy Jamal, who assured that work was continuing to establish the circumstances of the case

key_facts.fact: 案发五个月后，谋杀案的具体情况仍不清楚
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: However, five months after the crime, the circumstances surrounding the murder of Dom Osório Citora Afonso remain unclear.

uncertainties: 谋杀案的具体情节和实际作案人尚未查明
目前仅有单一来源（《O País》）报道，尚缺乏交叉验证
